cinecreate.configuration.scenes.tooltip: Each block's scene: start it with a right-click, with H, or not at all.
cinecreate.configuration.depot.tooltip: Lay items on the plate and pick them up by hand.
cinecreate.configuration.pressing.toolti: Lay items under the press and watch it come down. Clicking the press works too.
cinecreate.configuration.valve_handle.to: Pick the angle with the scroll wheel, then turn the wheel by hand.
cinecreate.configuration.mechanical_craf: Fill the crafters' windows by hand. Walls bigger than 3×3 need an Extendo Grip.
cinecreate.configuration.hand_crank.tool: Hold a mouse button to keep the crank turning.
cinecreate.configuration.basin.tooltip: Drop items in, pour from buckets and bottles, and scoop out what it makes.
cinecreate.configuration.blaze_burner.to: Feed fuel or a Blaze Cake through the cage.
cinecreate.configuration.spouting.toolti: Hold items under the spout while it fills them.
cinecreate.configuration.deploying.toolt: Hand items to the deployer above the depot.
Lay items in a fan's stream to wash, smoke, blast or haunt them.
cinecreate.configuration.item_drain.tool: Set buckets and bottles on the grate to empty them.
cinecreate.configuration.deployer.toolti: Swap what you hold with what the deployer holds.
cinecreate.configuration.millstone.toolt: Pour items in and gather what it grinds.
Lay items on the table and pick a shape to cut.
cinecreate.configuration.weighted_ejecto: Lay items on the plate and watch them fly.
cinecreate.configuration.invitation.tool: Shows "[H] Work at…" under the crosshair on blocks set to Key.
cinecreate.configuration.clientMode.tool: Plays the scenes on servers that don't have this add-on, using Create's normal clicks. Takes effect the next time you join.
At a Weighted Ejector, the view follows what it throws, then comes back.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.enabl: Turns every scene's particles on or off.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.amoun: How many particles the scenes spawn.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.follo: Fewer particles when Minecraft's own Particles option is lowered.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.depot: Small motes where items are set down.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.press: A ring and flying chips at each press stroke.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.valve: Air streaks around the turning wheel.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.hand_: Air streaks around the turning handle.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.blaze: Embers and heat haze above the fire.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.spout: Drops along the stream and a glint when filled.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.deplo: A ring when the deployer pushes.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.fan_p: The fan's air flowing across the plate.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.deplo: Motes as the items change hands.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.mills: Chips and flour dust while it grinds.
cinecreate.configuration.particles.mecha: Chips and sawdust from the blade.

cinecreate.settings.title: Cinematic Interactions: Create
cinecreate.settings.subtitle: Settings
cinecreate.settings.hint: Hover over a setting to see what it does.
cinecreate.settings.reset_all.tooltip: Sets everything back to default. Nothing is saved until you press Done.
cinecreate.settings.cancel.tooltip: Closes without saving. Esc does the same.
cinecreate.settings.done.tooltip: Saves and closes. Ctrl+Enter does the same.
cinecreate.settings.page.scenes.tooltip: Choose how each block's scene starts.
cinecreate.settings.page.view.tooltip: The camera at the ejector and on crafter walls.
cinecreate.settings.page.client.tooltip: Scenes on servers that don't have this add-on.
cinecreate.settings.scenes.intro: Click a card to switch between Click, Key and Off. Right-click goes back.
cinecreate.settings.all_click.tooltip: Every scene starts with a right-click.
cinecreate.settings.all_key.tooltip: Every scene starts with H; right-clicks work as normal.
cinecreate.settings.all_off.tooltip: No scenes; every block works as normal.
cinecreate.settings.client.state.none: You're not on a server right now.
cinecreate.settings.client.state.addon: This server has the add-on, so client mode isn't needed.
cinecreate.settings.client.state.active: Client mode is playing the scenes on this server.
cinecreate.settings.client.state.off: This server doesn't have the add-on. Turn on client mode and rejoin to get scenes.
cinecreate.settings.hands: To move where the hands work, turn on Developer mode in Cinematic Interactions' settings, then press G in a scene.
cinecreate.configuration.watchReach.tool: Launches that land farther away than this aren't followed.
cinecreate.configuration.wallMap.tooltip: With an Extendo Grip on a big crafter wall, shows which part you're looking at.
cinecreate.configuration.edgeTurn.toolti: With an Extendo Grip on a big crafter wall, rest the cursor at a screen edge to turn to the next part.
cinecreate.configuration.jolts.tooltip: A small camera kick on press strokes, impacts and launches.
cinecreate.configuration.flashes.tooltip: A soft flash when something is made.
cinecreate.settings.trigger.use.means: Click: right-click the block to start the scene.
cinecreate.settings.trigger.key.means: Key: right-click works as normal; press H to start the scene.
cinecreate.settings.trigger.off.means: Off: no scene, the block works as normal.
